newsitem.title: UK: York Hlngs extends offer for York Elect.
newsitem.headline: York Hlngs extends offer for York Elect.

text.p: Yorkshire Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it was extending its recommended cash offer for Yorkshire Electricity until 1500 hours on April 7,1997.
Yorkshire Holdings said it had received valid acceptances in respect of a total of 106.65 million shares representing 67.0 percent of Yorkshire Electricity's share capital.
The acceptances include elections for the Loan Note Alternative in respect of 1.39 million shares representing 0.9 percent of Yorkshire Electricity's issued share capital.

Yorkshire Holdings was jointly formed by American Electric Power Co Inc and Public Service Co of Colorado which made an agreed 1.5 billion stg bid for one Britain's last independent electricity companies.
